source.title: Competition did not use proper covers for puzzles
source.content:
Due to a miscommunication, Cavite Open 2 2018 did not have puzzle covers on hand. The organizers decided to use letter-sized paper and score sheets instead.

Video evidence confirms that significant portions of puzzles were visible to competitors and spectators before attempts. This violates Regulation A2c1:

> [A2c1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#A2c1)) The scrambler places a cover over the scrambled puzzle that makes it impossible for any competitors or spectators to see any part of the puzzle. The cover remains over the puzzle until the start of the attempt.

In addition, Guideline A2c1+) explicitly clarifies that paper or score sheets are not an acceptable substitute:

> [A2c1+](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/guidelines.html#A2c1+)) REMINDER In the past, score sheets have been used to cover puzzles while leaving some sides exposed. This is no longer permitted.

Although there is no evidence anyone specifically intended to cheat, this is a serious violation of scramble secrecy.
Per Motion [04.2019.1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/04.2019.1%20-%20Board%20of%20Directors.pdf) 2.8 and [Regulation 8f](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#8f), all results from Cavite Open 2 2018 have been removed.

translation.title: 比赛未使用合适的魔方遮盖物
translation.content:
由于沟通失误，Cavite Open 2 2018 未备有魔方罩，主办方决定改用信纸尺寸的纸张和成绩单。

视频证实，尝试开始前，选手和观众可以看见魔方的很大一部分。这违反了 A2c1：

> [A2c1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#A2c1) 打乱员须用遮盖物盖住打乱后的魔方，使任何选手或观众都看不到魔方任何部分。遮盖物须保留至尝试开始。

指导 A2c1+ 还明确说明，纸张或成绩单不能作为替代品：

> [A2c1+](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/guidelines.html#A2c1+) 提醒：过去曾用成绩单遮盖魔方，但仍暴露部分侧面。这种做法现已禁止。

虽然没有证据表明任何人明确意图作弊，但此事严重破坏了打乱保密性。根据动议 [04.2019.1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/04.2019.1%20-%20Board%20of%20Directors.pdf) 第 2.8 节及[规则 8f](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#8f)，Cavite Open 2 2018 的全部成绩已被删除。
